title: «Первый день дома и сейчас»
text:
Hi Threads 👋 We're TOBYDIC, a small team making simple daily wellness for dogs and cats.
Rescue parents, this one's for you. Reply with your pet's first-day-home photo and one from today 🐾
We'll share a few favorites on our Instagram.
note: Формат «до/после» усыновления — самые тёплые ответы. Отвечать каждому; у понравившихся спросить разрешение на репост.

title: Правило 3-3-3 для только что взятых из приюта
text:
Just adopted? The first weeks can feel messy, and that's normal. Here's the 3-3-3 rule shelters share with new families 🧵
—
3 days: decompress. Your new pet may hide, skip a meal or sleep a lot. Keep it quiet and skip the big welcome party.
3 weeks: learning the routine. Same walk times, same feeding spot. Their personality starts to show.
—
3 months: home. Most pets feel truly settled by now, but every pet has their own clock.
Not eating for more than a day or something feels off? Worth a call to your vet.
What surprised you most in the first week? 🐾
note: Правило 3-3-3 широко используют приюты США — польза, которую сохраняют и пересылают.

title: Гости на праздник и стеснительный питомец: тихий угол
text:
Holiday guests + a shy rescue = a lot for one little heart. Here's a calm-space checklist from pet parents who've been there 🧵
—
1. Set up a quiet room before guests arrive: bed, water, a familiar blanket.
2. Ask guests to let your pet come to them. No grabbing, no surprise hugs.
—
3. Keep walks and meals at the usual time, even on the big day.
4. Hiding all day, heavy panting or not eating? Give them space, and if it lasts, check in with your vet.
How does your pet handle a full house?

title: Собака просится на улицу каждый час: что записать до ветеринара
text:
Your dog suddenly asks to go out every hour? Before the vet visit, a few notes make it so much easier 🧵
—
1. How often. A rough count for a day or two.
2. How much. Big puddles or just a few drops?
3. Water. Drinking more than usual?
—
4. Anything new: food, routine, stress.
Straining, blood or can't go at all = call your vet today, don't wait.
Ever kept a "pee diary" for your dog? 😅
note: Боль «частое мочеиспускание» — без диагнозов, только что наблюдать и когда к ветеринару.

title: Травы — не мгновенная магия
text:
Honest talk: herbal isn't instant magic 🌿
—
Daily support works like brushing your teeth. Small, boring, every day. You won't see it on day two.
—
And it's never a replacement for your vet. Symptoms, pain or sudden changes = vet first, always.
What's one small habit you've kept for your pet for 30 days or more?
note: Голос TOBYDIC «Herbal ≠ instant magic» без товара и без продаж.

title: Зимняя сухая кожа: лайфхаки
text:

Humidifier, shorter baths, more brushing? Share yours 👇
Red, smelly or sore skin is a vet visit, not a home hack.
note: Тема кожи и шерсти (линия Yeast & Skin) через сезонную боль.

title: Первый визит к ветеринару после приюта: чек-лист
text:
Just adopted? Your first vet visit goes smoother with this list 🧵
—
Bring:
1. All shelter paperwork: vaccines, spay/neuter, microchip number.
2. A stool sample (yes, really). Vets often ask for one from new pets.
3. Notes from the first days: eating, potty, energy, sleep.
—
Ask:
4. Which vaccines and checkups are due.
5. What food and portion fits their age and weight.
What would you add for new adopters? 🐾
note: Тема ЖКТ/паразитов — только через «анализ у ветеринара», без слов dewormer / anti-parasitic.
